gen-gf-snowburst-one-manrope: Expressive and loud, Snowburst One stencils its tall lowercase with wide bridges. Manrope sits beneath with a marker-like line and bright gaps in every curve, so the heading's wild shapes get a steady, friendly voice to lean on.
gen-zen-dots-fs-rowan: Rowan reads like a friendly storyteller, its serif curves open and its thin strokes about half as heavy as the thick. Zen Dots sits nearby, spacious and techy, and the two get along surprisingly well.
gen-dafont-eraser-fs-literata: Eraser's bold letters have no thick-thin shifts at all, every curve as heavy as a rope. Literata follows with a text serif's soft contrast and wide-mouthed curves, which gives the heading something bookish to rest against.
gen-eater-fs-karma: Karma reads like an old trusted book, with serif terminals that finish well clear of the stem and almost no gap between x-height and caps. Eater's dark, aggressive shapes loom above it as a spooky counterweight.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-karma: Paprika scatters its letters wide, and its lowercase fills the line like capitals. Karma follows with a text serif's modest thick-thin variation, settling the heading's loud spacing into something trustworthy and classic.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-karma: Big, loose and brash, Revalia strides across widely separated letters. Karma, a text serif with a gentle modulation that never snags the eye, makes the heading's swagger feel grounded and trustworthy beside it.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-karma: Stencil cuts and tall lowercase make Snowburst One hard to ignore. Karma brings a serif with light but visible stroke variation, so the heading's loudness has a classic, trustworthy partner underneath it.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-karma: Karma is a classic serif, its terminals finishing well clear of the stem and its curves slightly thinner at the tops. And Tektur, with its pipe-cleaner strokes and outsized lowercase, gives all that tradition a distinctive, expressive foil.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-fs-karma: A splayed c terminal gives Tilt Neon its glowing, tube-like character in one constant width. Karma's text serif can stay at a modest size, where its tempered contrast does the quiet work.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-karma: Commanding, with a huge lowercase eye and daylight inside every curve, Unica One keeps every stroke at one thickness. Karma, a classic serif, changes its weight without drama, so a long page would feel trustworthy and unhurried.
